findings.text: Creation syscalls validate caller argument then delegate to a shared internal creator; one accepts only close on exec style flags while the legacy variant requires positive size and uses no flags.
Control syscall copies a small configuration record from user memory only for operations that carry one, then delegates to descriptor based control with blocking acquisition.

Wait syscalls share a common wait helper after normalizing timeout representation; variants add signal mask handling and either millisecond, timespec, or absent timeout forms including compat layouts.
Descriptor control resolves both descriptors to open files, builds a key from target file plus number, and dispatches to file oriented control.

File oriented control enforces poll support, wakeup privilege filtering, self insertion ban, exclusive mode restrictions, forced interest in error and hangup conditions, and distinct outcomes for duplicate add versus missing delete or modify.
Nonblocking harvest validates parameters then opportunistically transfers ready notifications without sleeping.

Target lookup by descriptor scans instance membership in order, skipping a given number of matches with same number while yielding voluntarily, and returns either the raw target file or a missing indicator under instance mutex.

Timeout handling treats negative as infinite wait, zero as immediate poll, and positive millisecond count as absolute deadline derived from current time plus offset; zero valued timespec bypasses sleep while nonzero arms an absolute timer with estimated slack.

Delivery detaches the item from ready tracking, reevaluates readiness while excluding concurrent control changes, and then either leaves it detached when idle, retains it for retry on user copy fault, disarms one shot interest, or requeues level interest for rechecking while edge interest stays detached until new activity.
User event record holds a readiness mask first followed by an opaque 64 bit token; successful store advances the user pointer by one record while fault reports failure without advancing.

Control lock uses a fast path when no nesting risk is visible and otherwise escalates to a global nesting mutex with generation counting; full checks validate nested insertion for cycles and depth, queue non nested leaves for companion review, and always clear temporary review state and bump generation on exit.
Nesting bound limits combined downward plus upward depth; reaching beyond the maximum or attempting to create a cycle is rejected.

Instance mutex serializes ready scans, membership lookup, and insertion or removal or mutation; a separate spin protected wait queue guards sleep and wakeup with final availability recheck under that spin protection; nested acquisition uses depth ordered level.
Upward depth traversal and temporary review list cleanup run under read side protection; membership iteration for nesting detection holds each visited instance mutex in turn.

Wait loop repeatedly checks availability, attempts bounded transfer, honors already expired or zero timeout, considers busy progress, aborts on pending signals, then sleeps exclusively with autoremove wakeup until wake or absolute expiry, carefully reconciling queue membership after wake before retrying.

Send scan aborts promptly when fatal signals are pending, moves ready items to a private batch under mutex, delivers up to caller limit while accumulating successes, preserves first fault only when nothing was delivered, then reconciles leftovers back to shared tracking before releasing mutex.
User copy failure during delivery does not lose the notification; the item is kept for a later attempt and stay awake state is restored, with fault propagated appropriately.
Wakeup source handoff activates the instance source before relaxing the item source when active, preventing unintended suspend around reactivation, and keeps source state aligned with linkage state.

Slack estimation derives tolerance from remaining wait duration scaled down by a fixed divisor, uses less reduction benefit for positively niced tasks, clamps to a global maximum, and honors zero thread slack as exact while otherwise taking at least thread slack.

Parameter validation requires positive bounded count, writable user area sized for that count, and correctly typed file; descriptor resolution failures map to bad descriptor, target without poll support maps to operation not permitted, and control races in nonblocking mode map to retry.

Operation selectors distinguish add, modify, and delete with only the first two carrying user configuration; mode flags select one shot, edge versus level retrigger, exclusive wake, and wakeup request, while error and hangup interest is always implied.
Creation flag for close on exec must match the generic descriptor flag; nesting depth and maximum transfer count are bounded by named limits.
Absolute timeout uses seconds plus nanoseconds fields; millisecond conversion splits into whole seconds and remainder nanos then adds safely to current time.
Autoremove wakeup performs normal wake then unconditionally detaches the waiter, so successive wakes progress across multiple waiters and thread teardown cannot strand entries.
Successful transfer with at least one notification triggers a network polling suspension hook before returning success.

Creation allocates an internal instance, obtains an anonymous file with a fresh descriptor honoring close on exec request, links the file back to the instance through a checked accessor, then publishes the descriptor; failure during file acquisition releases the instance.
